leader_skill.desc: 140% all parameters, 250% all elemental damage, 20% damage reduction for 1 turn when damage taken is over 5k, fills BB gauge each turn & 30% OD gauge fill rate
leader_skill.name: Summer Miracle

extra_skill.desc: 40% all parameters when Omni Star or Status Boosting sphere is equipped & add to BB (Fills BB gauge for 3 turns) when Omni Star or Status Boosting sphere is equipped, 20% all elemental damage for all allies, negates all status ailments and Atk, Def, Rec reduction, 150% spark damage & probable 2 KO resistance
extra_skill.name: Precious Memories

bb.desc: 15 combo Earth attack on all foes (damage relative to remaining HP), may activate BB/SBB/UBB twice for 3 turns, restores HP, fills OD gauge at turn's end for 3 turns, boosts OD gauge fill rate for 3 turns & may raise allies from KO
bb.name: Shining Dimension

sbb.desc: 18 combo Earth attack on all foes (damage relative to remaining HP), 12 combo Earth attack on single foe (or probable 5% damage of foes' max HP), boosts Atk, Def, Rec relative to max HP for 3 turns, boosts all elemental damage for 3 turns, may activate BB/SBB/UBB twice for 3 turns & fills OD gauge per ally (up to 18% max)
sbb.name: Iridescent Kiss

ubb.desc: 27 combo Earth attack on all foes (uses all allies' BB gauges), boosts all elemental damage for 4 turns, fills BB gauge for 4 turns, boosts Atk, Def, Rec relative to max HP for 4 turns, fills OD gauge & raises allies from KO
ubb.name: Sunbow Fantasy
